title: Towards Efficient LLM Inference via Collective and Adaptive Speculative Decoding
problem: LLM inference bottlenecked by autoregressive one-token-at-a-time decoding; speculative decoding limited by low SSM acceptance rate and high LLM verification cost.
motivation: Multi-SSM collaboration and pipelined verification can improve speculative decoding efficiency by increasing acceptance rate and hiding verification latency.
method: Smurfs: collective speculative decoding using majority-voted multiple SSMs; decouples SSM speculation from LLM verification with pipelined execution.
key_novelty: Multi-SSM majority voting for higher acceptance; dynamic speculation length tuning; pipelined decoupling of speculation and verification.
contributions: Collective speculative decoding with multiple SSMs
Superior throughput and latency vs state-of-the-art
